verdict.rationale: Sketch documents `sketchtool`, a command-line tool explicitly for creating/exporting assets programmatically, plus an official JavaScript plugin API and 'integrate into workflows and server applications' language, giving agents a documented surface to render/export designs; MCP support further lets AI clients drive Sketch. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of sketchtool's export formats and no explicit mention of headless/server rendering outside macOS, and no OpenAPI/REST surface was found (probe 404s).
